card.name: Verbs before everyday life objects
card.fires_on: Verbs or small words that come just before an expected everyday noun such as house, children, a job, food or life. The pole is strongest in general web prose about family and domestic life.

modes.label: Household and family verbs
modes.description: A verb or article sits right before a domestic or family object like house, birth or life.
modes.example: will help her daughter keep<< a>> house of her own some day.

modes.label: Daily-life activity verbs
modes.description: Verbs like finding, getting or preparing come before a job or food in a list of ordinary activities.
modes.example: getting an education,<< finding>> a job, marrying, and having children
